weather_report:
As the night deepens over Boston, the air is crisp, refreshing, and free from the haze of fog, which may uncharacteristically cloak the city at times. A serene stillness blankets the streets, with temperatures set to dip to a modest chill. Visible stars pepper the expansive sky, offering a glimpse of the beauty beyond the urban glow. When dawn arrives, it will unveil a day of clarity; the sun will rise over a landscape cradled by a light northward breeze, drawing warmth into the crispness.

When Wednesday brightens, expect a splendid interplay of sunshine and clouds. The bright daylight will bolster spirits, even as the temperature hovers near a chilly 45 degrees. It will be a day ideally suited for a cozy sweater beneath a tailored coat, perhaps completed with a knitted scarf to ward off the morning's brisk bite. A leisurely stroll along the river, meandering past autumn's lingering colors or a quiet moment in a local café, cradle a sense of contentment. Engage with the world outside, allowing the simple pleasures of enjoying a warm beverage or browsing the shelves of a nearby bookstore to punctuate the day.
